text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝟮𝟬𝟵! 🇮🇳

Santner and Duffy took 3 wickets each; Axar and Kishan made 46 apiece.
NZ are 29/1 after 6 overs, chasing 210 to level 2-2. Siraj got Seifert.

Can India defend it? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝟮𝟬𝟵 𝗠𝗔𝗜𝗡 𝗦𝗜𝗠𝗔𝗧 𝗚𝗔𝗬𝗘! 🇮🇳

👉 5th ODI decider mein India 42.1 over mein 209 pe all out
👉 Axar Patel aur Ishan Kishan ne 46-46 runs banaye
👉 NZ ko series 2-2 karne ke liye 210 chahiye; 6 over baad NZ 29/1, Siraj ne Seifert ko nikala

India ye score bacha payegi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
